## Code Sweep Report: Driveway Mechanic Site

### CRITICAL (Build/Runtime Failures)

**1. `lint` script will fail — no ESLint config file exists**
- `package.json` defines `"lint": "eslint . --ext .ts,.astro,.tsx"` but there is no `.eslintrc*` or `eslint.config.*` file anywhere in the repo.
- Additionally, ESLint v9 (which is what `^9.0.0` resolves to) uses flat config by default and **removed the `--ext` flag**. The script would fail on two counts: missing config file and unsupported CLI flag.
- **Fix:** Either create an `eslint.config.mjs` flat config, or remove the `lint` script until one is set up.

---

### HIGH (User-Visible Issues)

**2. `Article.astro` renders difficulty even when undefined**
- Lines 161-165 always render:

```161:165:src/layouts/Article.astro
        <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
          <span>🎯</span>
          <span class="capitalize">{frontmatter.difficulty}</span>
        </div>
```

- `difficulty` is optional in the schema. If an article omits it, this renders as a lonely target emoji with no text next to it.
- **Fix:** Wrap in a conditional: `{frontmatter.difficulty && ( ... )}`.

**3. Only 4 of 23 articles are published — most content is draft**
- Published (non-draft): `car-wont-start-clicks`, `how-to-change-oil-toyota-camry`, `best-obd2-scanners-2026`, `check-engine-light-on`
- All other 19 articles have `draft: true`
- This means the hub index pages (`/fix`, `/maintain`, `/buy`) will show very few articles at build time. The `/maintain` and `/buy` index pages will each show only 1 article. Not a bug per se, but worth noting for launch readiness.

---

### MEDIUM (Inconsistencies / Maintenance Risks)

**4. HUB_TO_SECTION mapping duplicated in 3 files**
- The same hub-to-section mapping is defined independently in:
  - `src/pages/rss.xml.ts` (lines 5-24)
  - `src/pages/learn/index.astro` (lines 21-27)
  - `src/layouts/Article.astro` (lines 39-58)
- If a new hub is added, all three must be updated in sync. Consider extracting to a shared util file like `src/lib/hub-sections.ts`.

**5. Hub lists duplicated between index and slug pages**
- `FIX_HUBS` is defined identically in both `src/pages/fix/index.astro` (line 5) and `src/pages/fix/[...slug].astro` (line 7). Same for `BUY_HUBS` and `MAINTAIN_HUBS` in their respective pairs.
- Same drift risk as #4.

**6. Hardcoded article links in homepage, footer, and 404 page**
- Homepage "Most Popular" section (lines 154-163 of `index.astro`) links to:
  - `/fix/car-wont-start-clicks`
  - `/maintain/how-to-change-oil-toyota-camry`
  - `/buy/best-obd2-scanners-2026`
- Footer "Popular Articles" (lines 218-223 of `Layout.astro`) links to those plus `/fix/check-engine-light-on`
- 404 page (lines 29-39 of `404.astro`) links to the same three

These are all currently published (non-draft), so they work **right now**. But if any of these articles are ever set back to `draft: true`, the links would point to pages that don't exist (no static page generated), causing 404s with no warning at build time.

**7. `cost-guide` articleType exists in schema but no route serves it**
- `content.config.ts` defines `articleType` with values including `"cost-guide"`, but:
  - `/fix/` routes filter by `"troubleshooting"`
  - `/maintain/` routes filter by `"how-to"` or `"maintenance-schedule"`
  - `/buy/` routes filter by `"buyer-guide"` or `"comparison"`
- An article with `articleType: "cost-guide"` would only appear in a section if it also had a matching hub. If it had no matching hub, it would be completely orphaned (no route generated).

**8. No dynamic slug routes for `/learn/` or `/seasonal/`**
- Both `/learn/index.astro` and `/seasonal/index.astro` exist, but there are no `[...slug].astro` files for these sections.
- The `/learn/` page cross-links articles using their hub-resolved section (e.g., links to `/fix/slug`), which is correct behavior.
- But if "learn" or "seasonal" hubs were ever assigned to articles, they'd fall through to the default `"fix"` section in `getArticleSection()` and wouldn't have their own routes.
